coverageNotes: Official US macro, energy and selected global central-bank sources; company earnings and geopolitical coverage is not yet connected.
Equity, index, FX, commodity and crypto prices and consensus require licensed providers.
Rolling ten NYSE trading-day news window includes intervening weekend/holiday news. Initial RSS history plus Fed archives; historical coverage is partial where sources lack accessible archives.

Longer-lived context uses topic review/expiry rules, not verified current policy status. Treasury observations retain up to one year; BLS series retain up to two years when the publisher key is configured.
Scheduled every 30 minutes; delivery may be delayed. Treasury values are daily observations.
